# Matter Atlas

[Explore the 3D periodic table](https://hallojoe.github.io/periodic-table/)

![Bohr models arranged in the periodic table with signed property heights](https://hallojoe.github.io/periodic-table/screenshots/bohr-table.png)

Switch between blocks and Bohr models, compare periodic trends, and inspect any of the 118 confirmed elements or two optional theoretical entries. One click selects an element. A second click pulls the camera back and brings its rotatable model into the foreground.
